s:the-shawshank-redemption-1994.title: The Shawshank Redemption
s:the-shawshank-redemption-1994.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
s:the-shawshank-redemption-1994.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
s:the-shawshank-redemption-1994.awards: Nominated for 7 Oscars. 21 wins & 43 nominations total

s:the-godfather-1972.title: The Godfather
s:the-godfather-1972.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

s:the-godfather-part-ii-1974.title: The Godfather Part II
s:the-godfather-part-ii-1974.overview: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
s:the-godfather-part-ii-1974.tagline: The rise and fall of the Corleone empire.

s:the-dark-knight-2008.title: The Dark Knight
s:the-dark-knight-2008.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.
s:the-dark-knight-2008.tagline: Some men just want to watch the world burn.

s:12-angry-men-1957.title: 12 Angry Men
s:12-angry-men-1957.overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.
s:12-angry-men-1957.tagline: It explodes like 12 sticks of dynamite!
s:12-angry-men-1957.awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 16 wins & 12 nominations total

s:schindler-s-list-1993.title: Schindler's List
s:schindler-s-list-1993.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
s:schindler-s-list-1993.tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

s:pulp-fiction-1994.title: Pulp Fiction
s:pulp-fiction-1994.overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.
s:pulp-fiction-1994.tagline: You won’t know the facts until you’ve seen the fiction.

s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-of-th.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-of-th.overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​
s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-of-th.tagline: There can be no triumph without loss. No victory without suffering. No freedom without sacrifice.

s:the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly-1966.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
s:the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly-1966.overview: While the Civil War rages on between the Union and the Confederacy, three men – a quiet loner, a ruthless hitman, and a Mexican bandit – comb the American Southwest in search of a strongbox containing $200,000 in stolen gold.
s:the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly-1966.tagline: For three men the Civil War wasn't hell. It was practice.

s:fight-club-1999.title: Fight Club
s:fight-club-1999.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
s:fight-club-1999.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 12 wins & 38 nominations total

s:forrest-gump-1994.title: Forrest Gump
s:forrest-gump-1994.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.
s:forrest-gump-1994.tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.

s:inception-2010.title: Inception
s:inception-2010.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
s:inception-2010.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-fellowship-o.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-fellowship-o.overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.
s:the-lord-of-the-rings-the-fellowship-o.tagline: One ring to rule them all.

s:the-empire-strikes-back-1980.title: The Empire Strikes Back
s:the-empire-strikes-back-1980.overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

s:the-matrix-1999.title: The Matrix
s:the-matrix-1999.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

s:goodfellas-1990.title: Goodfellas
s:goodfellas-1990.overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.
s:goodfellas-1990.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

s:one-flew-over-the-cuckoo-s-nest-1975.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
s:one-flew-over-the-cuckoo-s-nest-1975.overview: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.
s:one-flew-over-the-cuckoo-s-nest-1975.tagline: In this clean, orderly, disciplined world, who needs guys like McMurphy? Everybody.

s:seven-samurai-1954.title: Seven Samurai
s:seven-samurai-1954.overview: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.
s:seven-samurai-1954.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 5 wins & 9 nominations total

s:se7en-1995.title: Se7en
s:se7en-1995.overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
s:se7en-1995.tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.
s:se7en-1995.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 29 wins & 44 nominations total

s:the-silence-of-the-lambs-1991.title: The Silence of the Lambs
s:the-silence-of-the-lambs-1991.overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.
s:the-silence-of-the-lambs-1991.tagline: To enter the mind of a killer she must challenge the mind of a madman.

s:city-of-god-2002.title: City of God
s:city-of-god-2002.overview: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood, while José “Zé” Pequeno is an ambitious drug dealer diving into a dangerous life of crime.
s:city-of-god-2002.tagline: If you run, the beast catches you; if you stay, the beast eats you.
s:city-of-god-2002.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 76 wins & 50 nominations total

s:it-s-a-wonderful-life-1946.title: It's a Wonderful Life
s:it-s-a-wonderful-life-1946.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.
s:it-s-a-wonderful-life-1946.tagline: It's a wonderful laugh! It's a wonderful love!
s:it-s-a-wonderful-life-1946.awards: Nominated for 5 Oscars. 11 wins & 7 nominations total

s:life-is-beautiful-1997.title: Life Is Beautiful
s:life-is-beautiful-1997.overview: A touching story of an Italian book seller of Jewish ancestry who lives in his own little fairy tale. His creative and happy life would come to an abrupt halt when his entire family is deported to a concentration camp during World War II. While locked up he tries to convince his son that the whole thing is just a game.
s:life-is-beautiful-1997.tagline: An unforgettable fable that proves love, family and imagination conquer all.

s:saving-private-ryan-1998.title: Saving Private Ryan
s:saving-private-ryan-1998.overview: As U.S. troops storm the beaches of Normandy, three brothers lie dead on the battlefield, with a fourth trapped behind enemy lines. Ranger captain John Miller and seven men are tasked with penetrating German-held territory and bringing the boy home.

s:interstellar-2014.title: Interstellar
s:interstellar-2014.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
s:interstellar-2014.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

s:spirited-away-2001.title: Spirited Away
s:spirited-away-2001.overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.
s:spirited-away-2001.tagline: Beyond the tunnel was a mysterious town.

s:the-green-mile-1999.title: The Green Mile
s:the-green-mile-1999.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
s:the-green-mile-1999.tagline: Paul Edgecomb didn't believe in miracles. Until the day he met one.
s:the-green-mile-1999.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 15 wins & 37 nominations total

s:parasite-2019.title: Parasite
s:parasite-2019.overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
s:parasite-2019.tagline: Act like you own the place.

s:l-on-the-professional-1994.title: Léon: The Professional
s:l-on-the-professional-1994.overview: Léon, the top hit man in New York, has earned a rep as an effective "cleaner". But when his next-door neighbors are wiped out by a loose-cannon DEA agent, he becomes the unwilling custodian of 12-year-old Mathilda. Before long, Mathilda's thoughts turn to revenge, and she considers following in Léon's footsteps.
s:l-on-the-professional-1994.tagline: If you want the job done right, hire a professional.

s:the-usual-suspects-1995.title: The Usual Suspects
s:the-usual-suspects-1995.overview: Held in an L.A. interrogation room, Verbal Kint attempts to convince the feds that a mythic crime lord, Keyser Soze, not only exists, but was also responsible for drawing him and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro harbor – leaving few survivors. Verbal lures his interrogators with an incredible story of the crime lord's almost supernatural prowess.
s:the-usual-suspects-1995.tagline: Five criminals. One line up. No coincidence.

s:the-pianist-2002.title: The Pianist
s:the-pianist-2002.overview: The true story of pianist Władysław Szpilman's experiences in Warsaw during the Nazi occupation. When the Jews of the city find themselves forced into a ghetto, Szpilman finds work playing in a café; and when his family is deported in 1942, he stays behind, works for a while as a laborer, and eventually goes into hiding in the ruins of the war-torn city.
s:the-pianist-2002.tagline: Music was his passion. Survival was his masterpiece.

s:back-to-the-future-1985.title: Back to the Future
s:back-to-the-future-1985.overview: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. Marty must repair the damage to history by rekindling his parents' romance and - with the help of his eccentric inventor friend Doc Brown - return to 1985.
s:back-to-the-future-1985.tagline: He was never in time for his classes... He wasn't in time for his dinner... Then one day... he wasn't in his time at all.

s:terminator-2-judgment-day-1991.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
s:terminator-2-judgment-day-1991.overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

s:modern-times-1936.title: Modern Times
s:modern-times-1936.overview: A bumbling tramp desires to build a home with a young woman, yet is thwarted time and time again by his lack of experience and habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time...
s:modern-times-1936.tagline: He stands alone as the greatest entertainer of modern times! No one on earth can make you laugh as heartily or touch your heart as deeply...the whole world laughs, cries and thrills to his priceless genius!

s:psycho-1960.title: Psycho
s:psycho-1960.overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
s:psycho-1960.tagline: A new and altogether different screen excitement!
s:psycho-1960.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 8 wins & 14 nominations total

s:the-lion-king-1994.title: The Lion King
s:the-lion-king-1994.overview: Young lion prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself. Amid betrayal and tragedy, Simba must confront his past and find his rightful place in the Circle of Life.
s:the-lion-king-1994.tagline: The greatest adventure of all is finding our place in the Circle of Life.

s:gladiator-2000.title: Gladiator
s:gladiator-2000.overview: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.
s:gladiator-2000.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

s:american-history-x-1998.title: American History X
s:american-history-x-1998.overview: Derek Vineyard is paroled after serving 3 years in prison for killing two African-American men. Through his brother, Danny Vineyard's narration, we learn that before going to prison, Derek was a skinhead and the leader of a violent white supremacist gang that committed acts of racial crime throughout L.A. and his actions greatly influenced Danny. Reformed and fresh out of prison, Derek severs contact with the gang and becomes determined to keep Danny from going down the same violent path as he did.
s:american-history-x-1998.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 4 wins & 15 nominations total

s:the-departed-2006.title: The Departed
s:the-departed-2006.overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.
s:the-departed-2006.tagline: Cops or criminals. When you’re facing a loaded gun, what’s the difference?

s:whiplash-2014.title: Whiplash
s:whiplash-2014.overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.
s:whiplash-2014.tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.

s:the-prestige-2006.title: The Prestige
s:the-prestige-2006.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.
s:the-prestige-2006.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 6 wins & 44 nominations total

s:grave-of-the-fireflies-1988.title: Grave of the Fireflies
s:grave-of-the-fireflies-1988.overview: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.
s:grave-of-the-fireflies-1988.tagline: Why do fireflies have to die so soon?

s:casablanca-1942.title: Casablanca
s:casablanca-1942.overview: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
s:casablanca-1942.tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

s:apocalypse-now-1979.title: Apocalypse Now
s:apocalypse-now-1979.overview: At the height of the Vietnam war, Captain Benjamin Willard is sent on a dangerous mission that, officially, "does not exist, nor will it ever exist." His goal is to locate - and eliminate - a mysterious Green Beret Colonel named Walter Kurtz, who has been leading his personal army on illegal guerrilla missions into enemy territory.

s:alien-1979.title: Alien
s:alien-1979.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
s:alien-1979.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

s:memento-2000.title: Memento
s:memento-2000.overview: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.
s:memento-2000.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 57 wins & 59 nominations total

s:raiders-of-the-lost-ark-1981.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
s:raiders-of-the-lost-ark-1981.overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.
s:raiders-of-the-lost-ark-1981.tagline: The return of the great adventure.

s:the-great-dictator-1940.title: The Great Dictator
s:the-great-dictator-1940.overview: Dictator Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.
s:the-great-dictator-1940.tagline: Once again - the whole world laughs!
s:the-great-dictator-1940.awards: Nominated for 5 Oscars. 7 wins & 6 nominations total

s:django-unchained-2012.title: Django Unchained
s:django-unchained-2012.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
s:django-unchained-2012.tagline: Life, liberty, and the pursuit of vengeance.

s:cinema-paradiso-1988.title: Cinema Paradiso
s:cinema-paradiso-1988.overview: A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.
s:cinema-paradiso-1988.tagline: An enchanted village. A wonderful friendship. Star-crossed lovers. And the magic of the movies.

s:the-lives-of-others-2006.title: The Lives of Others
s:the-lives-of-others-2006.overview: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria.
s:the-lives-of-others-2006.tagline: Before the Fall of the Berlin Wall, East Germany's Secret Police Listened to Your Secrets.

s:wall-e-2008.title: WALL·E
s:wall-e-2008.overview: After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E— a robot designed to clean up the earth—discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that WALL•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans. Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.
s:wall-e-2008.tagline: After 700 years of doing what he was built for, he'll discover what he was meant for.

s:paths-of-glory-1957.title: Paths of Glory
s:paths-of-glory-1957.overview: A commanding officer defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.
s:paths-of-glory-1957.tagline: It explodes in the no-man's land no picture ever dared cross before!
s:paths-of-glory-1957.awards: Nominated for 1 BAFTA Award5 wins & 3 nominations total

s:the-shining-1980.title: The Shining
s:the-shining-1980.overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.

s:sunset-boulevard-1950.title: Sunset Boulevard
s:sunset-boulevard-1950.overview: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.

s:spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-2018.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
s:spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-2018.overview: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.
s:spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-2018.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
s:spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-2018.tagline: Enter a universe where more than one wears the mask.

s:oldboy-2003.title: Oldboy
s:oldboy-2003.overview: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.
s:oldboy-2003.tagline: 15 years of imprisonment, five days of vengeance.

s:dr-strangelove-1964.title: Dr. Strangelove
s:dr-strangelove-1964.overview: After the insane General Jack D. Ripper initiates a nuclear strike on the Soviet Union, a war room full of politicians, generals and a Russian diplomat all frantically try to stop it.
s:dr-strangelove-1964.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 14 wins & 11 nominations total

s:aliens-1986.title: Aliens
s:aliens-1986.overview: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.

s:coco-2017.title: Coco
s:coco-2017.overview: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

s:once-upon-a-time-in-america-1984.title: Once Upon a Time in America
s:once-upon-a-time-in-america-1984.overview: A former Prohibition-era Jewish gangster returns to the Lower East Side of Manhattan over thirty years later, where he once again must confront the ghosts and regrets of his old life.
s:once-upon-a-time-in-america-1984.tagline: Crime, passion and lust for power.
s:once-upon-a-time-in-america-1984.awards: Won 2 BAFTA Awards. 11 wins & 13 nominations total

s:das-boot-1981.title: Das Boot
s:das-boot-1981.overview: A German submarine hunts allied ships during the Second World War, but it soon becomes the hunted. The crew tries to survive below the surface, while stretching both the boat and themselves to their limits.
s:das-boot-1981.tagline: On land they dreamed of being heroes. Beneath the sea they pray to be survivors.
s:das-boot-1981.awards: Nominated for 6 Oscars. 15 wins & 12 nominations total

s:toy-story-1995.title: Toy Story
s:toy-story-1995.overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
s:toy-story-1995.tagline: Hang on for the comedy that goes to infinity and beyond!
s:toy-story-1995.awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 29 wins & 24 nominations total

s:amadeus-1984.title: Amadeus
s:amadeus-1984.overview: Disciplined Italian composer Antonio Salieri becomes consumed by jealousy and resentment towards the hedonistic and remarkably talented young Salzburger composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
s:amadeus-1984.tagline: The Man... The Music... The Madness... The Murder... The Motion Picture.

s:inglourious-basterds-2009.title: Inglourious Basterds
s:inglourious-basterds-2009.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.
s:inglourious-basterds-2009.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France...

s:princess-mononoke-1997.title: Princess Mononoke
s:princess-mononoke-1997.overview: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.
s:princess-mononoke-1997.tagline: The fate of the world rests on the courage of one warrior.

s:good-will-hunting-1997.title: Good Will Hunting
s:good-will-hunting-1997.overview: Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who is failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will's last chance is a psychology professor, who might be the only man who can reach him.
s:good-will-hunting-1997.tagline: Some people can never believe in themselves, until someone believes in them.

s:reservoir-dogs-1992.title: Reservoir Dogs
s:reservoir-dogs-1992.overview: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.

s:star-wars-1977.title: Star Wars
s:star-wars-1977.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
s:star-wars-1977.tagline: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...

s:2001-a-space-odyssey-1968.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
s:2001-a-space-odyssey-1968.overview: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the help of HAL 9000, the world's most advanced super computer.
s:2001-a-space-odyssey-1968.tagline: An epic drama of adventure and exploration.

s:vertigo-1958.title: Vertigo
s:vertigo-1958.overview: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.
s:vertigo-1958.tagline: Alfred Hitchcock engulfs you in a whirlpool of terror and tension!
s:vertigo-1958.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 9 wins & 8 nominations total

s:singin-in-the-rain-1952.title: Singin' in the Rain
s:singin-in-the-rain-1952.overview: In 1927 Hollywood, a silent film star falls for a chorus girl just as he and his paranoid screen partner struggle to make the difficult transition to talking pictures.
s:singin-in-the-rain-1952.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 11 wins & 11 nominations total

s:eternal-sunshine-of-the-spotless-mind-.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
s:eternal-sunshine-of-the-spotless-mind-.overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realises that he still loves her, and may be too late to correct his mistake.
s:eternal-sunshine-of-the-spotless-mind-.tagline: You can erase someone from your mind. Getting them out of your heart is another story.

s:citizen-kane-1941.title: Citizen Kane
s:citizen-kane-1941.overview: Newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane is taken from his mother as a boy and made the ward of a rich industrialist. As a result, every well-meaning, tyrannical or self-destructive move he makes for the rest of his life appears in some way to be a reaction to that deeply wounding event.
s:citizen-kane-1941.tagline: Some called him a hero...others called him a heel.

s:lawrence-of-arabia-1962.title: Lawrence of Arabia
s:lawrence-of-arabia-1962.overview: During World War I, English officer Thomas Edward 'T.E.' Lawrence sets out to unite and lead the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes to fight the Turks.

s:full-metal-jacket-1987.title: Full Metal Jacket
s:full-metal-jacket-1987.overview: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the U.S.-Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.
s:full-metal-jacket-1987.tagline: In Vietnam, the wind doesn't blow. It sucks.
s:full-metal-jacket-1987.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 8 wins & 15 nominations total

s:a-clockwork-orange-1971.title: A Clockwork Orange
s:a-clockwork-orange-1971.overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
s:a-clockwork-orange-1971.tagline: Being the adventures of a young man whose principal interests are rape, ultra-violence and Beethoven.
s:a-clockwork-orange-1971.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 12 wins & 26 nominations total

s:heat-1995.title: Heat
s:heat-1995.overview: Obsessive master thief Neil McCauley leads a top-notch crew on various daring heists throughout Los Angeles while determined detective Vincent Hanna pursues him without rest. Each man recognizes and respects the ability and the dedication of the other even though they are aware their cat-and-mouse game may end in violence.

s:the-truman-show-1998.title: The Truman Show
s:the-truman-show-1998.overview: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.

s:up-2009.title: Up
s:up-2009.overview: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.

s:taxi-driver-1976.title: Taxi Driver
s:taxi-driver-1976.overview: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.
s:taxi-driver-1976.tagline: On every street in every city in this country, there's a nobody who dreams of being somebody. He's a lonely forgotten man desperate to prove that he's alive.

s:die-hard-1988.title: Die Hard
s:die-hard-1988.overview: High above the city of L.A. a team of terrorists has seized a building, taken hostages, and declared war. One man has manages to escape... An off-duty cop hiding somewhere inside. He's alone, tired... and the only chance anyone has got.
s:die-hard-1988.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 8 wins & 8 nominations total

s:jurassic-park-1993.title: Jurassic Park
s:jurassic-park-1993.overview: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.
s:jurassic-park-1993.tagline: An adventure 65 million years in the making.

s:no-country-for-old-men-2007.title: No Country for Old Men
s:no-country-for-old-men-2007.overview: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.

s:the-big-lebowski-1998.title: The Big Lebowski
s:the-big-lebowski-1998.overview: Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebowski, a Los Angeles slacker who only wants to bowl and drink White Russians, is mistaken for another Jeffrey Lebowski, a wheelchair-bound millionaire, and finds himself dragged into a strange series of events involving nihilists, adult film producers, ferrets, errant toes, and large sums of money.
s:the-big-lebowski-1998.tagline: Times like these call for a Big Lebowski.

s:blade-runner-1982.title: Blade Runner
s:blade-runner-1982.overview: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

s:blade-runner-1982.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 13 wins & 22 nominations total

s:trainspotting-1996.title: Trainspotting
s:trainspotting-1996.overview: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. s:withnail-i-1987.title: Withnail & I
s:withnail-i-1987.overview: Two out-of-work actors -- the anxious, luckless Marwood and his acerbic, alcoholic friend, Withnail -- spend their days drifting between their squalid flat, the unemployment office and the pub. s:the-third-man-1949.title: The Third Man

s:oppenheimer-2023.title: Oppenheimer

s:dune-part-two-2024.title: Dune: Part Two

s:everything-everywhere-all-at-once-2022.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
s:everything-everywhere-all-at-once-2022.overview: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.
s:everything-everywhere-all-at-once-2022.tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.

s:get-out-2017.title: Get Out
s:get-out-2017.overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. s:get-out-2017.tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.

s:mad-max-fury-road-2015.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
s:mad-max-fury-road-2015.overview: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. s:mad-max-fury-road-2015.tagline: The future belongs to the mad.

s:fargo-1996.title: Fargo
s:fargo-1996.overview: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying. Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha!
s:fargo-1996.tagline: A lot can happen in the middle of nowhere.

s:hot-fuzz-2007.title: Hot Fuzz
s:hot-fuzz-2007.overview: Former London constable Nicholas Angel finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Angel smells something rotten in the idyllic village.
s:hot-fuzz-2007.tagline: Big cops. Small town. Moderate violence.

s:shaun-of-the-dead-2004.title: Shaun of the Dead
s:shaun-of-the-dead-2004.overview: Shaun lives a supremely uneventful life, which revolves around his girlfriend, his mother, and, above all, his local pub. This gentle routine is threatened when the dead return to life and make strenuous attempts to snack on ordinary Londoners.

s:kind-hearts-and-coronets-1949.title: Kind Hearts and Coronets
s:kind-hearts-and-coronets-1949.overview: When his mother eloped with an Italian opera singer, Louis Mazzini was cut off from her aristocratic family. s:brief-encounter-1945.title: Brief Encounter
s:brief-encounter-1945.overview: Returning home from a shopping trip to a nearby town, bored suburban housewife Laura Jesson is thrown by happenstance into an acquaintance with virtuous doctor Alec Harvey. Their casual friendship soon develops during their weekly visits into something more emotionally fulfilling than either expected, and they must wrestle with the potential havoc their deepening relationship would have on their lives and the lives of those they love.
s:brief-encounter-1945.tagline: A story of the most precious moments in a woman's life!
s:brief-encounter-1945.awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 4 wins & 3 nominations total

s:local-hero-1983.title: Local Hero
s:local-hero-1983.overview: An American oil company sends a man to Scotland to buy up an entire village where they want to build a refinery. But things don't go as expected.
s:local-hero-1983.tagline: A BEAUTIFUL COASTLINE... A RICH OIL MAN WANTS TO DEVELOP IT. A POOR BEACH BUM WANTS TO LIVE ON IT. AN ENTIRE TOWN WANTS TO PROFIT BY IT. AND A REAL-LIVE MERMAID WANTS TO SAVE IT... ONLY ONE OF THEM WILL GET THEIR WAY.

s:paddington-2-2017.title: Paddington 2
s:paddington-2-2017.overview: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.
s:paddington-2-2017.awards: Nominated for 3 BAFTA 15 wins & 50 nominations total

s:anatomy-of-a-fall-2023.title: Anatomy of a Fall
s:anatomy-of-a-fall-2023.overview: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

s:the-zone-of-interest-2023.title: The Zone of Interest
s:the-zone-of-interest-2023.overview: The commandant of Auschwitz, Rudolf Höss, and his wife Hedwig, strive to build a dream life for their family in a house and garden next to the camp.

s:breaking-bad-2008.title: Breaking Bad
s:breaking-bad-2008.overview: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. s:the-wire-2002.title: The Wire
s:the-wire-2002.overview: Told from the points of view of both the Baltimore homicide and narcotics detectives and their targets, the series captures a universe in which the national war on drugs has become a permanent, self-sustaining bureaucracy, and distinctions between good and evil are routinely obliterated.
s:the-wire-2002.awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 18 wins & 59 nominations total

s:the-sopranos-1999.title: The Sopranos
s:the-sopranos-1999.overview: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. s:chernobyl-2019.overview: The true story of one of the worst man-made catastrophes in history: the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl. A tale of the brave men and women who sacrificed to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.

s:chernobyl-2019.awards: Won 10 Primetime Emmys. 87 wins & 60 nominations total

Based on Stephen E. Ambrose's acclaimed book of the same name.
s:band-of-brothers-2001.tagline: There was a time when the world asked ordinary men to do extraordinary things.

s:game-of-thrones-2011.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. s:better-call-saul-2015.title: Better Call Saul

s:the-office-2001.title: The Office
s:the-office-2001.overview: Nightmare boss. Tedious colleagues. Pointless tasks. Welcome to Wernham Hogg. Fancy a tea break with David Brent? Classic comedy from the archive.

s:fawlty-towers-1975.overview: Owner Basil Fawlty, his wife Sybil, a chambermaid Polly, and Spanish waiter Manuel attempt to run their hotel amidst farcical situations and an array of demanding guests.

s:sherlock-2010.title: Sherlock

s:sherlock-2010.tagline: A new sleuth for the 21st century.
s:sherlock-2010.awards: Won 9 Primetime Emmys. 95 wins & 185 nominations total

s:peaky-blinders-2013.title: Peaky Blinders

s:line-of-duty-2012.title: Line of Duty
s:line-of-duty-2012.overview: A drama about the investigations of AC-12, a controversial police anticorruption unit.
s:line-of-duty-2012.tagline: If you think catching criminals is tough, try catching police officers.
s:line-of-duty-2012.awards: Nominated for 13 BAFTA 21 wins & 61 nominations total

s:happy-valley-2014.title: Happy Valley
s:happy-valley-2014.overview: Happy Valley is a dark, funny, multi-layered thriller revolving around the personal and professional life of Catherine, a dedicated, experienced, hard-working copper. She is also a bereaved mother who looks after her orphaned grandchild.

s:black-mirror-2011.title: Black Mirror
s:black-mirror-2011.overview: Twisted tales run wild in this mind-bending anthology series that reveals humanity's worst traits, greatest innovations and more.
s:black-mirror-2011.awards: Won 6 Primetime Emmys. 48 wins & 186 nominations total

s:twin-peaks-1990.title: Twin Peaks
s:twin-peaks-1990.overview: The body of Laura Palmer is washed up on a beach near the small Washington state town of Twin Peaks. FBI Special Agent Dale Cooper is called in to investigate her strange demise only to uncover a web of mystery that ultimately leads him deep into the heart of the surrounding woodland and his very own soul.
s:twin-peaks-1990.awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 19 wins & 45 nominations total

s:the-twilight-zone-1959.title: The Twilight Zone
s:the-twilight-zone-1959.overview: An anthology series containing drama, psychological thriller, fantasy, science fiction, suspense, and/or horror, often concluding with a macabre or unexpected twist.
s:the-twilight-zone-1959.tagline: You are about to enter another dimension.
s:the-twilight-zone-1959.awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 12 wins & 14 nominations total

s:seinfeld-1989.title: Seinfeld
s:seinfeld-1989.overview: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.
s:seinfeld-1989.awards: Won 10 Primetime Emmys. 81 wins & 197 nominations total

s:friends-1994.title: Friends
s:friends-1994.overview: Six young people from New York City, on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.

s:the-simpsons-1989.title: The Simpsons
s:the-simpsons-1989.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.
s:the-simpsons-1989.tagline: Just a product of society that's lost its good manners.

s:arrested-development-2003.title: Arrested Development
s:arrested-development-2003.overview: The story of a wealthy family that lost everything, and the one son who had no choice but to keep them all together.

s:curb-your-enthusiasm-2000.title: Curb Your Enthusiasm
s:curb-your-enthusiasm-2000.overview: The off-kilter, unscripted comic vision of Larry David, who plays himself in a parallel universe in which he can't seem to do anything right, and, by his standards, neither can anyone else.

s:blackadder-1983.title: Blackadder

s:only-fools-and-horses-1981.title: Only Fools and Horses
s:only-fools-and-horses-1981.overview:
Only Fools and Horses.... Is a British sitcom created and written by John Sullivan. Seven series were originally transmitted on BBC One from 1981 to 1991, with sixteen sporadic Christmas specials aired until 2003.

In working-class Peckham in south-east London, ambitious market trader Derek 'Del Boy' Trotter and his younger half-brother Rodney, explore their highs and lows in life, in particular their attempts to get rich.

Initially not an immediate hit and receiving little promotion early on, it later achieved consistently high ratings, and the 1996 episode "Time on Our Hands" (originally billed as the series finale) holds the record for the biggest UK audience for a sitcom episode, attracting 24.3 million viewers. The series bears a significant influence on British culture, contributing several words and phrases to the English language.
